# GdayMeetings 0.2.0

- Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at `/mcp` with the `search_meetings` tool; clients no longer need a local Node or pnpm process.
- Optional dedicated read-only MCP bearer credential (`GDAY_MCP_TOKEN`).
- Payload CMS recordings, task inputs, immutable typed outputs, durable worker callbacks, and downloadable results.
- SQLite by default, optional Postgres, persistent audio storage, and production migrations.

## Container image

`ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.2.0` and `:latest` support Linux AMD64 and ARM64.

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.2.0
```

Copy `.env.example` to `.env`, set independent random secrets and your public `SERVER_URL`, then run `docker compose up -d`. Connect your MCP client to `https://your-host/mcp` using the configured bearer token. Complete the first administrator setup on a trusted network before exposing the application.

See the [README](https://github.com/rankun203/gday-meetings/blob/v0.2.0/README.md) for deployment, Postgres, and client configuration.
